activity.notes: User-supplied CARACALLA is normalized to Caracalla. Oxford identifies him as Roman emperor 198–217 CE: Augustus from 198 and sole ruler after Geta's death in 211. ATLAS preserves the full official imperial tenure.

sources.title: Caracalla, Roman emperor - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Caracalla as Roman emperor from 198 to 217 CE, Augustus from 198 and sole ruler after 211.
